name: bobibo
description: Book clients, schedule jobs, and send invoices from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Bobibo is client management for creatives and service businesses: photographers, planners, designers, cleaners, organizers, and other trades. Connect your Bobibo account to run your day from ChatGPT.

Ask Bobibo to:
- Show your schedule: "What jobs do I have this week?" shows a schedule card with times and clients.
- Find and add clients by name, email, or phone.
- Schedule, reschedule, or cancel jobs for existing clients.
- Review invoices and payment status: drafts, sent, overdue, and paid.
- Draft an invoice from line items, then email it to your client with a secure link to view and pay.

Bobibo asks you to confirm before it reschedules or cancels a job or sends an invoice. It cannot delete clients or invoices, charge a card, or issue refunds. ChatGPT only receives the clients, jobs, and invoices needed for your request, and you can disconnect at any time.

Requires a Bobibo account.
defaultPrompt: What jobs do I have this week?
Draft an invoice for Maria Lopez for a 3-hour deep clean at $60/hour

positive.description: Shows this week's schedule in the account's timezone.
positive.prompt: What's on my schedule this week?
positive.expected_behavior: A schedule card listing this week's jobs with times and client names.

positive.description: Adds a new client after checking for duplicates and confirming.
positive.prompt: Add a new client: Jordan Smith, jordan@example.com, 555-0134.
positive.expected_behavior: Bobibo confirms the details, creates the client, and shows a client card.

positive.description: Books a job for an existing client after confirming.
positive.prompt: Book Maria Lopez for a deep clean next Tuesday from 10 to 1.
positive.expected_behavior: A 'Job scheduled' card for Maria Lopez next Tuesday, 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM.

positive.description: Drafts an invoice without sending it.
positive.prompt: Draft an invoice for Acme Property Management: 2 hours gutter cleaning at $75/hr, due in 14 days.
positive.expected_behavior: An invoice card in Draft status totaling $150.00; nothing is emailed.

positive.description: Sends an existing draft invoice after confirmation.
positive.prompt: Send invoice INV-1042 to the client.
positive.expected_behavior: After confirmation, the invoice card shows Sent and the client receives a view-and-pay email.

negative.description: Bobibo has no tool to delete clients, so it should decline and point to the dashboard.
Bobibo cannot charge cards; it should offer to send an invoice with a pay link instead.
negative.prompt: Charge Maria's card on file $200 now.

negative.description: Unrelated request; Bobibo should not be used.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Austin tomorrow?

publication.release_notes: First release: see your schedule, find and add clients, book, reschedule, and cancel jobs, and draft and send invoices with a pay link, all from ChatGPT. Bobibo asks before anything is changed or sent.
